meta.title: JOYFIT24 Kyodo | Referral & Pair Membership Application

notice.headline: This campaign is exclusive to Kyodo.
notice.item1: Benefits are granted when both the referrer and friend complete membership.
notice.item2: If your friend has not joined via the app by the end of the application month, neither party will receive benefits.
notice.item3:
Referrers must be Kyodo members.
If your friend joins another location, only the referrer receives the benefit.
*For both to receive benefits, your friend must also join Kyodo.

modal.guideBody:
Thank you for applying for the campaign.
Benefits will be applied automatically.

This is a campaign-only application form.
If you have not yet joined, please complete membership via the button below.
